description: This file defines the OrderStatus class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to create, read, update, delete, and manage order status records in the database, including handling multi-language descriptions and caching. It is used to manage order status data within the admin module of the system.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Manages order status records including creation, update, deletion, retrieval, and description management in multiple languages.

methods.name: addOrderStatus
methods.description: Creates a new order status record in the database, handling multiple languages and updating cache.

methods.name: editOrderStatus
methods.description: Edits an existing order status by deleting it and re-adding descriptions, then clears cache.

methods.name: deleteOrderStatus
methods.description: Deletes an order status record from the database and clears cache.

methods.name: deleteOrderStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all order status records associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getOrderStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific order status record for a given ID.

methods.name: getOrderStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of order statuses, potentially filtered by language and with pagination, utilizing caching.

methods.name: getTotalOrderStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of order status records for a given language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific order status in a particular language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for order statuses in a specified language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Fetches a specific description of an order status in a given language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Provides all descriptions for a given order status ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Returns all order status descriptions in a specific language.
